name: TrendRadar v6 AI News and Trend Monitor
description: Track trends on Chinese and global platforms with AI summaries and alerts.

upstream.version: v6.11.0 (tag 2026-10-13, commit ceabb02); MCP server mcp-v4.1.1 (same commit)

PORT.description: Port Caddy listens on; the public domain and Railway's healthcheck use it.

REPORTS_USERNAME.description: Login name for the report pages (HTTP basic auth). Letters, digits and . _ @ - only.

REPORTS_PASSWORD.description: Report password, generated at deploy (at least 12 characters). Change it here and redeploy the gateway.

REPORTS_PUBLIC.description: true removes the login from the report pages (the MCP route keeps its token). Reports show your keyword interests.

REPORTS_UPSTREAM.description: Private host:port of the trendradar report server.

MCP_UPSTREAM.description: Private host:port of the trendradar-mcp service; empty makes /mcp answer 404.

MCP_URL.description: Informational: the URL to put in your MCP client, with the trendradar-mcp MCP_TOKEN as bearer token.

PORT.description: Port of the private report server (also Railway's healthcheck port). The gateway proxies to it.

TZ.description: IANA timezone (e.g. Europe/Istanbul, Asia/Shanghai) for the container clock and CRON_SCHEDULE.

TIMEZONE.description: TrendRadar timezone for report dates, file names and push windows. Follows TZ.

CRON_SCHEDULE.description: Five-field crontab for crawls (supercronic inside the container). Digits, * / , - and spaces only.

IMMEDIATE_RUN.description: Run one crawl at every boot, so a report exists right after deploy.

REPORT_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Days of dated HTML report snapshots kept on the volume (pruned daily). 0 keeps everything.

CONFIG_LANGUAGE.description: Starting config: en (English config and labels) or zh (upstream Chinese config). Applied on first boot or with CONFIG_RESEED.

CONFIG_RESEED.description: true copies the default config files again on the next boot (old ones backed up on the volume). Set back to false afterwards.

CONFIG_YAML.description: Optional. Full contents of config.yaml (platforms, RSS feeds, report mode, AI options). Replaces the file on every boot.

FREQUENCY_WORDS.description: Optional. Full contents of frequency_words.txt (your keyword groups). Replaces the file on every boot.

AI_INTERESTS.description: Optional. Full contents of ai_interests.txt, used when the AI filter is on (filter.method: ai).

PLATFORMS_API_URL.description: Hot-list API. Default: the private newsnow service. Set https://newsnow.busiyi.world/api/s to use the public instance instead.

STORAGE_BACKEND.description: remote keeps the daily SQLite history in the Railway Bucket (the MCP service reads it from there); local keeps it on the volume.

S3_ENDPOINT_URL.description: S3 endpoint of the template's Railway Bucket.

S3_BUCKET_NAME.description: S3 bucket name of the Railway Bucket.

AI_API_KEY.description: Optional. LLM API key for AI analysis, translation and the AI filter (LiteLLM). AI stays off while this is empty.

AI_MODEL.description: Optional. LiteLLM model id provider/model, e.g. deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash (config default), openai/gpt-4o or gemini/gemini-2.5-flash.

AI_API_BASE.description: Optional. OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. OpenRouter, a proxy or Ollama); prefix AI_MODEL with openai/ when you use it.

AI_ANALYSIS_ENABLED.description: Optional. true/false. Empty = on when AI_API_KEY is set. AI briefing in each report and push.

AI_TRANSLATION_ENABLED.description: Optional. true/false. Empty = on when AI_API_KEY is set. Translates RSS and standalone titles.

AI_TRANSLATION_LANGUAGE.description: Optional. Target language for AI translation (config default English).

AI_FILTER_ENABLED.description: Optional. true switches the hot-list filter from keywords to AI interest classification (costs tokens every run).

SCHEDULE_ENABLED.description: Optional. true turns on upstream's push schedule (timeline.yaml); empty keeps the config default (off: push after every crawl).

SCHEDULE_PRESET.description: Optional. Schedule preset when SCHEDULE_ENABLED=true: always_on, morning_evening, office_hours or night_owl.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Optional. Telegram bot token from @BotFather. Set together with TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID; several accounts separated by ;.

TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.description: Optional. Telegram chat id that receives the pushes (same count as tokens).

GENERIC_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Optional. Generic webhook URL (Discord, Matrix, IFTTT, n8n and others).

GENERIC_WEBHOOK_TEMPLATE.description: Optional. JSON body for the generic webhook with {title} and {content} placeholders, e.g. {"content": "{content}"} for Discord.

NTFY_TOPIC.description: Optional. ntfy topic to push to.

NTFY_SERVER_URL.description: Optional. ntfy server URL; empty uses https://ntfy.sh.

NTFY_TOKEN.description: Optional. ntfy access token for protected topics.

FEISHU_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Optional. Feishu / Lark bot webhook URL.

WEWORK_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Optional. WeCom (WeChat Work) bot webhook URL.

WEWORK_MSG_TYPE.description: Optional. WeCom message type: markdown (group bot, default) or text (personal WeChat via a WeCom app).

EMAIL_FROM.description: Optional. Sender address for email reports. Outbound SMTP works only on Railway Pro; prefer a webhook channel.

EMAIL_PASSWORD.description: Optional. SMTP password or app password for EMAIL_FROM.

EMAIL_SMTP_SERVER.description: Optional. SMTP host; auto-detected from EMAIL_FROM when empty.

EMAIL_SMTP_PORT.description: Optional. SMTP port; auto-detected when empty.

PORT.description: Port of the MCP server (streamable HTTP at /mcp, healthcheck /healthz).

MCP_TOKEN.description: Bearer token every MCP request must send (Authorization: Bearer {token}). Generated at deploy.

MCP_SYNC_DAYS.description: Days of crawler history copied from the Bucket for the MCP tools.

MCP_SYNC_INTERVAL.description: Seconds between Bucket syncs (today's database changes after every crawl).

S3_ENDPOINT_URL.description: S3 endpoint of the template's Railway Bucket.

S3_BUCKET_NAME.description: S3 bucket name of the Railway Bucket.

TZ.description: Timezone, same as the trendradar service.

TIMEZONE.description: TrendRadar timezone, same as the trendradar service.

CONFIG_LANGUAGE.description: Same starting config as the trendradar service.

CONFIG_YAML.description: Same config.yaml override as the trendradar service (empty = defaults).

FREQUENCY_WORDS.description: Same keyword groups as the trendradar service (empty = defaults).

AI_INTERESTS.description: Same AI interests file as the trendradar service (empty = defaults).

PLATFORMS_API_URL.description: Hot-list API for the trigger_crawl tool, same as the trendradar service.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Same as trendradar (used by the send_notification tool).

TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.description: Same as trendradar (used by the send_notification tool).

SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Same as trendradar (used by the send_notification tool).

GENERIC_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Same as trendradar (used by the send_notification tool).

GENERIC_WEBHOOK_TEMPLATE.description: Same as trendradar (used by the send_notification tool).

NTFY_TOPIC.description: Same as trendradar (used by the send_notification tool).

NTFY_SERVER_URL.description: Same as trendradar (used by the send_notification tool).

NTFY_TOKEN.description: Same as trendradar (used by the send_notification tool).

BARK_URL.description: Same as trendradar (used by the send_notification tool).

FEISHU_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Same as trendradar (used by the send_notification tool).

DINGTALK_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Same as trendradar (used by the send_notification tool).

WEWORK_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Same as trendradar (used by the send_notification tool).

WEWORK_MSG_TYPE.description: Same as trendradar (used by the send_notification tool).

EMAIL_FROM.description: Same as trendradar (used by the send_notification tool).

EMAIL_PASSWORD.description: Same as trendradar (used by the send_notification tool).

EMAIL_TO.description: Same as trendradar (used by the send_notification tool).

EMAIL_SMTP_SERVER.description: Same as trendradar (used by the send_notification tool).

EMAIL_SMTP_PORT.description: Same as trendradar (used by the send_notification tool).

PORT.description: Port of the newsnow API (private only; healthcheck /api/latest).

HOST.description: Listen on all IPv4 and IPv6 addresses (dual stack) for the private network.

INIT_TABLE.description: Create newsnow's cache table on start.

ENABLE_CACHE.description: Cache each source for its refresh interval (about 10 minutes), which also rate-limits calls to the source sites.

PRODUCTHUNT_API_TOKEN.description: Optional. Product Hunt API token, only needed if you add the producthunt source to your platforms.
